shown.message:
Outline rev. 15 is pushed (3f8e24a). It records the uploader-grouping check from `experiment-repo` (`story-repo`#7) in the caveats for the Open LLM Leaderboard (OLB) matrix.

- **Result:** holding out whole uploaders (717 groups) instead of family stems (475) leaves the held-out-group result unchanged.
  - The floor is 4.79 against 4.82.
  - The gain of the designed run set over random selection is within the family run's intervals.
  - The k needed to get within 25% of the floor is 5 [3, 5] against 3 [3, 5], one grid step apart.
- **What I changed:** the family-stem leakage caveat now says the held-out-group result does not rest on that heuristic. The strongest-quarter split was not re-grouped, so the caveat still stands for it.

Nothing else needs doing. The text in `paper-repo` already treats the family heuristic as a stated caveat, and this check only narrows it.
